score_policy.name: strategy_quality_score
score_policy.meaning: Completeness of the selected strategy's own setup definition.
score_policy.note: No probability, win rate or expectancy is claimed anywhere in this system.

findings.defect: Simple rolling mean of gains/losses instead of Wilder smoothing.
findings.remediation: Wilder recursive smoothing seeded with the first n-period SMA.

findings.defect: SMA of true range; seed bar included without a previous close.
findings.remediation: Wilder-smoothed true range; seed bar dropped; gaps measured.

findings.defect: Returned mean(abs(up-down))/mean(TR); no +DI/-DI; not on the ADX scale.
findings.remediation: Full DM -> Wilder smooth -> +DI/-DI -> DX -> smoothed ADX, with graded bands.

findings.defect: Both EMAs seeded at values[0].
findings.remediation: SMA-seeded EMAs; adds zero_line_state, cross and histogram_slope.

findings.defect: Values returned before indicator warm-up.
findings.remediation: warmup_for() per family; values gated to None with an explicit readiness map.

findings.defect: Two independent scoring systems that could disagree.
findings.remediation: One StrategyEvaluation; confluence is a view of the selected evaluation.

findings.defect: Hard-coded candidate scores (SMC 8, AMD 9, TREND 7, MOMENTUM 6, BREAKOUT 6, MEAN_REVERSION 5).
findings.remediation: Removed; ranking is on evaluated evidence only.

findings.defect: Hard-coded H1/M15/M5 regardless of the SWING profile.
findings.remediation: Every strategy reads timeframes from the TradingProfile.

findings.defect: READY while RSI and HTF evidence failed; thresholds inconsistent with confluence.
findings.remediation: MACD regime, RSI side, RSI exhaustion, HTF and entry are all hard requirements.

findings.defect: close beyond max(high) of candles[-6:-1] -- any five-bar window.
findings.remediation: Protected-swing state machine; closed-candle confirmation only.

findings.defect: Poke beyond the prior five bars.
findings.remediation: Raid of an identified pool (confirmed swing / equal highs-lows / session level) with a reclaim.

findings.defect: max/min of the last 200 candles.
findings.remediation: Anchored to the impulse leg of the latest structure event; basis reported.

findings.defect: Read the displacement flag of the LATEST candle.
findings.remediation: Displacement measured on the candle that formed the gap.

findings.defect: Never enforced; a 200-candle-old gap was still valid.
findings.remediation: formation_index/expiry_index enforced; a late touch cannot revive an expired zone.

findings.defect: Any INVALIDATED FVG became an IFVG candidate.
findings.remediation: Inversion inherits source qualification; retest required for confirmation.

findings.defect: Fixed 20/10 windows; distribution decided from follow[-1], allowing out-of-order completion.
findings.remediation: Strictly ordered phase machine; each phase searched only after the previous one ended.

findings.defect: Not implemented; effectively the all-time high/low of the loaded history.
findings.remediation: Trading-day grouping with an explicit timezone and rollover hour; single preceding day.

findings.defect: Symbol-name substring matching; no crypto/index/energy classes.
findings.remediation: Broker-metadata classification via trade_calc_mode and currency fields.

findings.defect: loss_per_lot fell back to (distance/tick_size)*tick_value -- invalid cross-currency.
findings.remediation: order_calc_profit authoritative; fallback labelled non-authoritative and refused for execution.

findings.defect: Derived from a stored margin_per_volume scalar.
findings.remediation: order_calc_margin authoritative; blocks when unavailable.

findings.defect: Distance-only; transaction costs invisible.
findings.remediation: Gross and net RR from one authoritative input set; net enforced.

findings.defect: Never validated; orders rejected with retcode 10016.
findings.remediation: Tick-grid rounding plus stops_level/freeze_level validated on the correct side of the book.

findings.defect: Hard-coded per bucket; FX pip limits reachable for metals.
findings.remediation: Measurement / rolling observation / policy separated; class-aware units; relative gates.

findings.defect: Substring relevance; news adjusted the technical score by up to -2.
findings.remediation: Relevance from broker currency fields; score_adjustment always 0; routes to manual approval.

findings.defect: R-multiple measured from the mid price.
findings.remediation: Valued at the closing side: Bid for a long, Ask for a short.

findings.defect: Break-even +1R and ATR trail +2R for every strategy.
findings.remediation: Per-strategy STRATEGY_MANAGEMENT policy; mean reversion has no +1R break-even.

findings.defect: Lots treated as currency units, identical on both legs.
findings.remediation: True notional from contract_size and price; portfolio aggregation.

findings.defect: Two candle lists zipped by position.
findings.remediation: Timestamp-aligned pairing with reported sample counts.

findings.defect: Single stale status; no market-schedule awareness.
findings.remediation: Distinct blocker codes; schedule-aware freshness; gap detection.

findings.defect: No OrderCheck; analysis-time values reused at execution.
findings.remediation: Ten-stage preflight ending in OrderCheck, run immediately before execution.

findings.defect: No pullback requirement; entered fully extended moves.
findings.remediation: Fresh-pullback and not-overextended hard gates in ATR terms.

findings.defect: No acceptance or spike test.
findings.remediation: Closed break, displacement, spike guard, acceptance and viable-target hard gates.

findings.defect: Band touch plus extreme RSI was treated as a reversal.
findings.remediation: Non-trending regime and band re-entry are hard gates.

test_suite.note: The failure is pre-existing and caused by a missing pytesseract dependency in an unrelated vision skill.

not_verified.reason: Code path and blocker handling tested; no real response observed.
